notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition Update v1.3.6 is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/e0ace360f2922c2c907f72dcd1b168658d089d37.jpg[/img]

We’ve just released [b]version 1.3.6[/b], focusing on bug fixes based on your helpful feedback. ✨

[Fix] Resolved an issue preventing card purchases when the Magister card was played on the Consul or Senator.
[Fix] Fixed a softlock occurring after playing the Diplomat card on the Magister.
[Fix] Implemented minor stability improvements.

And while you're here, we’ve got exciting news: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580][b]Inkborn[/b][/url], a roguelike deckbuilder, which is our first original game project (not a digital adaptation of board game) is set to release on [b]Early Access in Q2 2025[/b]! 🖤🖋️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580

What sets [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580][b]Inkborn[/b][/url] apart? 🃏
[b]Inkborn[/b] introduces an innovative card combo system, where players unlock powerful moves by sequencing cards strategically - bringing the excitement of classic fighting game combos into a fresh and unique twist. Combined with our distinctive Origami-inspired art style and a dynamic roster of evolving character classes, every run offers a new and exciting experience. At launch, you'll have access to over 100 different cards to experiment with, and we’re just getting started - expect more characters and cards to be added post-launch! [b]Full Release[/b] 👉 [b]Q2 2026[/b].

This going in-and-out is particularly important because, amongst other things, we're introducing the Live Play online game mode, and the online play servers are separate between the current Beta branch and the live patch that we have. So when in Beta, you won't see your normal online games, and vice versa (but you can just jump back and everything will be as you left it.
